parent_diagnosis.frozen_conclusion: Independent private relation phases are approximately zero-centered on identical uniform geometry but have a reproducible positive conditional-null expectation on matched and shifted heterogeneous Q5 geometry under the frozen Q5.1 TTF-C estimator.

scientific_target: Test whether the final per-system residual-SD normalization inside Q5.1 length_orthogonalized_turnover is a necessary contributor to the supported heterogeneous-geometry conditional-null bias.

mechanistic_basis.linear_stage: Within-system rank turnover is linearly residualized against within-system edge-length rank. This centering/projection is linear in the response and therefore commutes with averaging over independently redrawn private relation phases.
mechanistic_basis.nonlinear_stage: Q5.1 then divides each realized residual vector by its own population SD and rescales to the fixed target SD of an equally spaced rank01 vector. This phase-dependent normalization is nonlinear and need not commute with phase averaging under heterogeneous geometry.
mechanistic_basis.prediction: If this nonlinear normalization contributes the positive conditional-null expectation, removing only the final residual-SD rescaling should reduce the phase-averaged TTF-C null score toward zero on fresh heterogeneous geometry while the frozen normalized estimator remains positively biased.

normalized_q51.training_response: rank01(coupling turnover), linearly residualized against rank01(edge length), then rescaled by target_sd / residual_sd exactly as length_orthogonalized_turnover
normalized_q51.score: ordinary held-out within-system Spearman, equal-system macro mean

unscaled_residual_ablation.single_change: Omit only the final target_sd / residual_sd multiplication after the exact Q5.1 centered rank-length projection on each training system.
unscaled_residual_ablation.training_response: raw centered rank-length residual, with no per-system residual-SD rescaling
unscaled_residual_ablation.evaluation_response: unchanged raw held-out coupling turnover rank

fresh_worlds.freshness: No geometry world or private-phase redraw from the conditional-null centering diagnosis may be reused.

predeclared_mechanism_tests.matched_normalized_bias_replication: SUPPORTED iff lower95 of across-geometry mean conditional_mean_normalized_C in DNB_MATCHED is > 0.
predeclared_mechanism_tests.matched_normalization_contribution: SUPPORTED iff lower95 of paired across-geometry mean (conditional_mean_normalized_C - conditional_mean_unscaled_C) in DNB_MATCHED is > 0.
predeclared_mechanism_tests.matched_unscaled_recentered: SUPPORTED iff the two-sided 95% bootstrap CI for mean conditional_mean_unscaled_C in DNB_MATCHED contains 0.
predeclared_mechanism_tests.primary_normalization_bias_mechanism: SUPPORTED iff matched_normalized_bias_replication, matched_normalization_contribution, and matched_unscaled_recentered are all supported.
predeclared_mechanism_tests.shifted_normalized_bias_replication: SUPPORTED iff lower95 of mean conditional_mean_normalized_C in DNB_SHIFTED is > 0.
predeclared_mechanism_tests.shifted_normalization_contribution: SUPPORTED iff lower95 of paired normalized-minus-unscaled mean in DNB_SHIFTED is > 0.
predeclared_mechanism_tests.shifted_unscaled_recentered: SUPPORTED iff the two-sided 95% bootstrap CI for mean conditional_mean_unscaled_C in DNB_SHIFTED contains 0.
predeclared_mechanism_tests.homogeneous_negative_control: Report both estimators and their paired difference without using this cell to select or tune any correction.

terminal_rule.if_supported: Freeze only the normalization-bias mechanism diagnosis. The unscaled residual estimator is not thereby selected. Any corrective estimator requires a separately named prospective development family with a new frozen prediction and fresh worlds.
terminal_rule.if_not_supported: Freeze the negative diagnosis and do not tune residual-SD normalization, shrinkage, clipping, floors, or alternative scale factors on these worlds.
